promise: Keep scoped evidence and derived facts retrievable beyond one agent session.
audience: People and agents who need inspectable, durable project memory.
trigger: Remember, retrieve, revise or inspect durable project evidence.

modes.name: Remember
modes.output: Verbatim evidence scoped to its project and source.

modes.name: Retrieve
modes.when: A current task needs relevant past evidence.
modes.output: Scoped source-linked results with currency qualified.

modes.name: Maintain
modes.when: A claim changed or retained records need review.
modes.output: Explicit supersession, export or authorized forgetting.

examples.title: Fictional worked example
examples.before: A remembered conclusion is reused as current fact with no source.
examples.after: Scoped evidence and a provenance-linked superseding fact preserve what was known and when.
examples.why: Durable retrieval stays separate from unverified claims of current truth.

verification.evidence: No live model, real desktop transaction, invitation, deployment or production data migration was performed by this functional baseline.

publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.

marketing.headline: Pick up the evidence, not just the summary.
marketing.lead: Keep scoped source notes, find them in a later session and trace derived facts back to what was actually recorded. Start with a small explicit evidence CLI; add automatic capture only when you need it.

benefits.title: Return to the source
benefits.body: Store verbatim evidence with project scope and provenance so a later answer can cite the record behind it.

benefits.title: Keep changes inspectable
benefits.body: Separate evidence from derived facts and navigation. Supersede a stale fact while retaining the evidence trail.

benefits.title: Start without a model
benefits.body: The explicit native evidence CLI saves and searches local notes without a host, background daemon or embedding model.

walkthrough.title: Keep one useful note
walkthrough.detail: File a fictional parser-check note in a named project and room. Record where it came from rather than saving a conclusion without context.

walkthrough.title: Find it in a later process
walkthrough.detail: Search the same native log for parser. Lexical/BM25 retrieval returns matching evidence and its reference without asking a model to reconstruct the past.

walkthrough.title: Review what changed
walkthrough.detail: Read the source before treating an old claim as current. Derived facts cite evidence; later facts supersede earlier ones without erasing the original record.

use_when: A later session needs the exact project note behind a decision.
You need evidence, derived facts and navigation to stay distinguishable.
You want scoped local records you can inspect and preserve.
not_for: You only need to pass the next task between agents: Project Handoff is a smaller starting point.
You need physical deletion simply by invalidating a fact.
You expect installing a method folder to activate automatic memory or migrate existing stores.
marketing.quickstart_prompt: Use Memory to review this project note. Preserve the exact source, its project scope and the date. Separate observed evidence from any derived claim. Show what needs rechecking before we rely on it today.
marketing.output_preview:
Project: fictional-parser
Evidence: "Parser check remains unverified."
Source: fictional-note

Later retrieval:
  exact source text + content reference
  scoped to this project

Current truth: recheck before relying on it
marketing.example_note: This fictional example shows the evidence trail. The native quickstart lets you test a real local save and fresh-process search with temporary fictional data.
install_notes: The portable skill is guidance. It installs without a database or Memory runtime.
For a working native save/search check, follow docs/NATIVE-QUICKSTART.md. Python 3.11+, Rust and a native compiler are needed for source Data installs.
The reviewed public Data library stays independent. Existing stores are never discovered or migrated by installation.
marketing.proof_summary: The public native path is checked with temporary evidence, two scoped consumers, regeneration and durable restart. Full embedding, host and live-task acceptance remain separate; historical retrieval results keep their original protocol limits.
marketing.next_step: Choose the portable guidance or the native quickstart. Save one fictional note first, then verify you can find the same words in a fresh process.

name: amplifier-capability-memory
version_basis: Existing project metadata; not a new published tag or package release; an exact Git pin selects source for the shared portable installer.

portable_method.name: memory
portable_method.contract: Agent Skills directory; caller applies the method; no independent execution loop is installed.

portable.input: Caller task and explicitly authorized context
portable.output: Keep scoped evidence and derived facts retrievable beyond one agent session.
portable.failure: Report insufficient evidence, unsupported context or host limitation; never turn discovery into an execution claim.

native.status: Existing declared entrypoints preserved; runtime signatures, service access and installation tests remain separate evidence.

installation.scope: Shared canonical portable installer only; not the legacy repository helper or native package installation.

runtime.status: Host/caller authorizes each operation; installation is not a tool allowlist or standing approval.
declared_boundaries: Portable method installation is independent; native persistence depends on the separate amplifier-data substrate and supported adapters.

secret_names.native_runtime_inventory: See native documentation; no credentials are bundled or inferred.

dataflow.installation: Shared canonical portable installer only (https://michaeljabbour.github.io/reports/capability-installer/): read portable source tracked at the explicit Git pin and copy locally with SHA-256 receipts; no source text is transmitted. Legacy repository helpers copy current working-tree files and do not uniformly enforce Git pins, tracked membership or hash receipts. Native package builds and downloads have separate network, execution and storage flows described in their installation documentation.
dataflow.method: Caller supplies authorized context; existing promise and boundaries govern output.
dataflow.native_runtime: Provider/network/storage flows are owned by native interfaces and host authorization; these files do not enable them.

source_policy.revision: The shared canonical portable installer (https://michaeljabbour.github.io/reports/capability-installer/) requires an explicit full 40-character Git commit and never infers latest. This guarantee does not apply uniformly to legacy or native installers; the legacy repository helper is an operator-controlled working-tree copy without Git-pin, tracked-membership or SHA-256 receipt enforcement.
source_policy.repository_rename: Public identity may change; skill folder, imports, entrypoints, tool IDs and schemas remain stable.
source_policy.research: .research/market remains local and ignored; AGENTS governs refresh.

film.heading: The words just traveled.
film.blurb: In 64 seconds, a vendor promise turns into a myth by spring, and a houseplant named Fern pays for it. Then Memory keeps the first words with their project, call and date, hands them back weeks later, and links a newer fact to its source without throwing the old one away. Captions are on the player; a transcript is below.
film.note: Fern, the vendor and the call are a fictional example. The film shows how the skill behaves; it does not report results.

shared_portable.applies_when: portable_method is declared; otherwise describe native interfaces without executing installation
guarantees: Tracked portable source membership and source-byte checks

legacy_repository.documentation: Existing install_commands and repository installation documentation, where provided.
legacy_repository.source_policy: Operator-controlled current working-tree copy. It can include untracked files and can operate outside a Git checkout; no uniform Git pin or SHA-256 transaction receipt is enforced.
legacy_repository.permissions: Review the specific command and destination; shared-installer transaction and permission guarantees do not describe this route.

native.documentation: interfaces.native, runtime_install_commands and project installation documentation, where provided.
native.source_policy: Native packaging, host composition and download routes retain their own version and provenance rules; shared portable receipt guarantees do not automatically apply.
native.permissions: Package builds may execute build tools; dependency or artifact downloads may use the network. Review the documented command, dependencies, destination and runtime authorization separately.
